## Purpose 
<!--- One sentence to describe the purpose of this PR, refer to any linked issues:
#14 -- this will link to issue 14
Closes #2 -- this will automatically close issue 2 on PR merge
-->
This refactors the `set_sgs_moments_and_cloud_fraction!` function to use the `foreach_point` construct (part of #4745).


## To-do
<!---  list of proposed tasks in the PR, move to "Content" on completion 
- Proposed task
-->
- [x] Pass the fields to `foreach_point` directly. (Leaving this as DataLayouts because there is an issue when using the Fields)

## Content
<!---  specific tasks that are currently complete 
- Solution implemented
-->
- This uses `foreach_point` to fuse the broadcasted evaluations of sgs moments and cloud fraction into a single kernel. The runtime of the function is reduced by 20%.
- Also uses local caching for `sgs_moments` inside `foreach_point` although this has negligable impact. It's possible the compiler is doing this optimisation anyway.
- Removes repeated computation of `ᶜq_lcl + ᶜq_icl`. This reduces register usage.

Using the `sgs.jl` test case in `perf/run-and-time/`:

| Case | Mean runtime (ms) | Registers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Baseline | 1.398 | 201 & 173 |
| `foreach_point` | 1.133 | 225 |
| + local caching | 1.129 | 225 |
| + `ᶜq_c` | 1.134 | 219 |

body:
If the relevant IC files were missing, ClimaAtmos previously stopped at an error telling you to go run WeatherQuest's Python script by hand. It now fetches and converts the data itself. 

Changes
- Depend on [InitialConditions.jl](https://github.com/CliMA/InitialConditions.jl/), which will be registered on Sep 25. `weather_model_data_path` now calls `InitialConditions.ERA5.fetch_initial_conditions` when no raw file is present.
- Add `to_z_levels_3d_model` in `src/utils/era5_model_levels.jl`, ported from WeatherQuest. ERA5 stores the atmosphere on hybrid levels whose height varies per column with surface pressure and temperature, so it reconstructs geopotential height by hydrostatic integration over the IFS coefficients, then interpolates each column onto the target altitudes. Pressure comes from the same coefficients and is written as p_3d, interpolated in log pressure.
title: Fetch ERA5 initial conditions with InitialConditions.jl

The EDMF surface scalar coefficient, the baroclinic wave factor, the idealized insolation constants, the non-orographic gravity wave number and the gray radiation inputs are computed in `FT` to avoid unintended type promotion to `Float64`. `Float64` results are unchanged.

`Float32` results change in the last bits, so the reference counter moves to 418.

## Purpose
This PR replaces the balance-derived `l_TKE` in the mixing-length closure with a single empirical form that unifies the Lopez-Gomez production-dissipation balance and a bounded amplitude:

l_TKE = l_inf · √x · (1 + x) · exp(−x)  
where
τ_ε = c_tke · √(c_d/a_pd),   capped at τ_ε_max
x   = TKE / (l_inf / τ_ε)²

- **Small-x limit** (weak TKE / strong forcing): `(1 + x)·exp(−x) → 1`, so `l_TKE → τ_ε · √TKE = c_tke · √(c_d/a_pd) · √TKE` — the Lopez-Gomez P = ε balance scale (with the `c_tke` prefactor).

- **Adaptive reference TKE** `tke_ref = (l_inf/τ_ε)²`: stronger local forcing (smaller `τ_ε`) raises `tke_ref`, so higher TKE is admitted before the decay kicks in.

- **Bounded amplitude**: `l_TKE` peaks at `x = 1` with `max(l_TKE) = (2/e)·l_inf ≈ 0.74·l_inf`. Beyond the peak, `(1 + x)·exp(−x)` provides a self-limiting brake that damps runaway TKE without touching the local shear/buoyancy balance in the sub-peak regime.

- **`τ_ε_max`** caps the local dissipation timescale, representing the residual eddy turnover from background processes. The cap is inert wherever local production is strong (`c_tke·√(c_d/a_pd) ≪ τ_ε_max`).

## New parameters (ClimaParams v1.1.17)
  
Three parameters are used:
  
  | Parameter                    | Default | Units  | Role                                                                                          |
  |------------------------------|---------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `mixing_length_tke_coeff`    | 1.05    | –      | `c_tke`: prefactor on the LG balance timescale (`τ_ε = c_tke·√(c_d/a_pd)`).|
| `mixing_length_tke_l_inf`    | 200     | m      | Base BL mixing length; peak `l_TKE ≈ 0.74·l_inf`.|
| `mixing_length_tke_tau_max`  | 600     | s      | Cap on `τ_ε`; residual eddy turnover time for background processes.|
